notes.title: Case Closed: A Final Thank You
notes.content:
Dear Detectives,

We’ve come to the final chapter in the journey of The Last Case of Benedict Fox, and we want to extend our sincere gratitude to every single one of you who joined us. Thank you for playing our game, for delving into its mysteries, and for sharing your feedback along the way. It has been an honor for us to bring you some entertainment, especially during tough times of the pandemic and in the period shortly after.

Throughout the development, we faced countless challenges and embraced every lesson they brought. It was a humbling experience that shaped us into better creators. We learned, adapted, and grew.
Some of you may have noticed our recent quiet spell. That’s because we’ve been hard at work on our next projects. We’ve taken the lessons learned from Benedict’s case - both the triumphs and the mistakes - and we’re feeling more optimistic than ever about what’s coming next. We can’t show anything just yet, but please keep your eyes peeled for future announcements.

Finally, thank you all once again - whether your reviews were positive or critical, whether you played for hours or simply dropped in for a puzzle or two. Your passion and dedication have meant everything to us and fueled our determination to improve.

We’ll be back soon, stronger than ever. For now, let us close this case.


Until next time,

Your Plot Twist Team

notes.title: The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition is Now Available to Play!
notes.content:
Dear Detectives,

Exciting news! [b]The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition has arrived![/b] Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of Limbo all over again. A host of new features and additions await. And the best part? This update is all yours, ready to be downloaded, all for free. 

[previewyoutube=Vx_Xx3qAvXk;full][/previewyoutube]
The Definitive Edition adds a whole lot of new content and gameplay updates, including a new combat arena that’s full of fun challenges and fantastical fights with demons, new story content that delves deeper into the past of Benedict and his demon companion and loads more. All of you seasoned players will also instantly notice the refined combat and traversal changes, an accelerated flow that speeds up combat, improved and adjusted animations, and more responsive movement. All of these changes have been made based on your feedback, so thank you graciously for all your help, time, and feedback here. We appreciate it. [b]And for the very first time, you can also play The Last Case of Benedict Fox on PlayStation 5.[/b]

If you haven't got your copy of the game yet, now's the perfect time to do it! Take advantage of our [b]60% discount[/b] and see for yourself what secrets that Mansion holds. The discount is for a limited time, so grab the game now before the sale runs out.


Until next time,

Your Plot Twist Team

notes.title: The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition Update is Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Detectives,

We are thrilled to unveil that [b]The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition is coming on March 26, 2024![/b] The Definitive Editions brings new content and improvements. And all current players will receive the Definite Edition update at no extra cost.

[previewyoutube=QXhgPsbmIkE;full][/previewyoutube]
So what’s new that’s coming with the Definitive Edition? Well, first we’ve included the Limbo area, a new place in which you can test your combat skills. We’ve added new terrifying secrets and puzzles that are waiting to be solved in the Mansion. We’ve also worked hard to improve the combat, making it more fluid and dynamic and we enhanced the exploration too. Plus, we're excited to announce the inclusion of Brazilian Portuguese and Chinese (Simplified) languages in the game. And finally, for the very first time, The Last Case of Benedict Fox will be available to play on PlayStation 5. 

Mark March 26th in your calendars, detectives. It’s time to re-enter the world of Limbo.


Until next time, 

Your Plot Twist Team

notes.title: New Patches and Updates

Our first patch addressed hotfixes needed after the launch. Our upcoming patches will have more comprehensive changes for the game. We’ll keep continuing to support the game after these patches, but we’ll be prioritizing these fixes first based on what’s most impactful.

notes.title: Обзор The Last Case of Benedict Fox
notes.content: The Last Case of Benedict Fox — один из немногих игровых проектов, заинтересовавших меня с самого анонса. Приятная графика, необычный сеттинг и мрачный оккультизм обещали что-то действительно оригинальное. К сожалению, финальный продукт оказался тем самым ребенком польского инкубатора, который в концепции всегда выглядит лучше, чем на релизе. Но это вовсе не значит, что игра совсем не заслуживает вашего внимания — скорее, вы должны взвесить все за и против, прежде чем погружаться в это приключение.

notes.title: Game Patch 1 - Performance and Save Improvements
notes.content:
Hello detectives, 

Thank you for all your support. We are reading (and whenever we can, responding to) your feedback! Keep it coming! We are working harder than ever to improve the game in all aspects. And this patch is just the beginning. 

This patch addresses:

[b]Fix: [/b]Flashlight exploit failsafe (we love the persistence from you guys!)
[b]Fix: [/b]Achievements fix
[b]Fix: [/b]Ink and Bits and Pieces summary on the map adjusted
[b]Improvement: [/b]Performance improvements
[b]Improvement: [/b]Autosave frequency increased

In addition to other fixes, we’re also working on tackling the big tough stuff soon:
[list]
[*] Alternative controller layouts
[*] Map markers and piano puzzle difficulty rebalancing
[*] Mouse and keyboard remapping
[*] Brazillian Portuguese Localization (yes, we heard you!)
[*] Continued performance improvements
[/list]

The Steam patch is up with Xbox and PC Game Pass following shortly. Thank you so much for playing! Keep that feedback coming in. We are dedicated to continuing to improve the game. This patch is just the start and we'll have more updates in the coming weeks!

Until next time, 

Your Plot Twist team

Enjoy,

notes.title: New gameplay and trailer revealed and Gamescom award won!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

Although Gamescom seems now like a distant memory, it’s definitely one that we won’t forget for a long time. During that week in Cologne, we showed a lot more from The Last Case of Benedict Fox. So for all of you that missed out on all the Gamescom news, here are both of our new videos in one place.

Let’s start with our deep dive into the gameplay itself. Showcased at the Future Games Show from Gamescom, our Creative Director Bartek took the audiences on a tour of the mansion and the world of limbo. You can take that tour yourself down below:

[previewyoutube=YveOtjKDqfs;full][/previewyoutube]

That wasn’t all that we had planned for the show. We also revealed a brand new gameplay trailer which you can watch it right here.

[previewyoutube=wJ7vZZI9CgE;full][/previewyoutube]

And finally, some fantastically-unexpected news for our studio. The Last Case of Benedict Fox won the Most Wanted Microsoft Xbox Game Award at Gamescom 2022! To say we are stunned is an understatement. This is a huge honour for our studio and it was an absolute blast hearing the news that we won. Below you can watch our Bartek accept the award on the main Opening Night Live stage. What a moment that was for all of us Plot Twisters.

[previewyoutube=CJM8MVoIAXA;full][/previewyoutube]

So, what did you think of the new gameplay videos? Does the atmosphere intrigue you? How about the gameplay? How do you feel about Benedict’s powers and tattoos? We want to hear all about it from you, so let us know all your thoughts in the comment section below.


Until next time,

Your Plot Twist Team
